class CustomerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_default_credit_limit_and_balance(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(c.credit_limit, Money(0))
        self.assertEqual(c.balance, Money(0))

    def test_constructor_stores_fields(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "Alice", Money(1000))
        self.assertEqual(c.customer_id, "C-1")
        self.assertEqual(c.name, "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(c.credit_limit, Money(1000))
        self.assertIsInstance(c, Entity)

    def test_default_limit_not_shared_across_instances_semantics(self) -> None:
        # Money is immutable, so the shared default is safe; verify value semantics.
        self.assertEqual(Customer("C-1", "A").credit_limit, Customer("C-2", "B").credit_limit)

    def test_empty_customer_id_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            Customer("   ", "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(str(ctx.exception), "customer_id required")

    def test_non_str_customer_id_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            Customer(None, "Alice")  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_empty_name_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            Customer("C-1", "")
        self.assertEqual(str(ctx.exception), "name required")

    def test_non_str_name_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            Customer("C-1", 5)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_non_money_credit_limit_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            Customer("C-1", "Alice", 1000)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_identity_is_customer_id(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(Customer("C-9", "Z").identity(), "C-9")

    def test_equality_by_customer_id(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(Customer("C-1", "A"), Customer("C-1", "B"))
        self.assertNotEqual(Customer("C-1", "A"), Customer("C-2", "A"))

    def test_can_afford_true_within_limit(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A", Money(1000))
        self.assertTrue(c.can_afford(Money(1000)))

    def test_can_afford_false_over_limit(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A", Money(1000))
        self.assertFalse(c.can_afford(Money(1001)))

    def test_can_afford_accounts_for_existing_balance(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A", Money(1000))
        c.charge(Money(600))
        self.assertTrue(c.can_afford(Money(400)))
        self.assertFalse(c.can_afford(Money(401)))

    def test_can_afford_non_money_rejected(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            Customer("C-1", "A", Money(1)).can_afford(1)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_charge_increases_balance(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A", Money(1000))
        c.charge(Money(300))
        self.assertEqual(c.balance, Money(300))
        c.charge(Money(200))
        self.assertEqual(c.balance, Money(500))

    def test_charge_exceeding_limit_raises_and_keeps_balance(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A", Money(100))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            c.charge(Money(101))
        self.assertEqual(str(ctx.exception), "credit limit exceeded")
        self.assertEqual(c.balance, Money(0))

    def test_charge_exactly_to_limit_allowed(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A", Money(100))
        c.charge(Money(100))
        self.assertEqual(c.balance, Money(100))

    def test_charge_non_money_propagates_type_error(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            Customer("C-1", "A", Money(100)).charge(5)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_read_only_properties(self) -> None:
        c = Customer("C-1", "A")
        with self.assertRaises(AttributeError):
            c.balance = Money(5)  # type: ignore[misc]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class OrderEqualityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_equal_by_order_id(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(_order("ORD-1"), _order("ORD-1"))

    def test_not_equal_different_id(self) -> None:
        self.assertNotEqual(_order("ORD-1"), _order("ORD-2"))

    def test_eq_non_order_returns_not_implemented(self) -> None:
        self.assertIs(_order().__eq__("ORD-1"), NotImplemented)
        self.assertFalse(_order("ORD-1") == "ORD-1")

    def test_hash_by_id(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(hash(_order("ORD-1")), hash(("Order", "ORD-1")))
        self.assertEqual(len({_order("ORD-1"), _order("ORD-1")}), 1)

    def test_repr_includes_status(self) -> None:
        o = _order("ORD-7")
        self.assertEqual(repr(o), "Order('ORD-7', new)")
        o.advance(OrderStatus.CANCELLED)
        self.assertEqual(repr(o), "Order('ORD-7', cancelled)")


class OrderBuilderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_constructor_type_checks(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            OrderBuilder("alice", FlatPricing())  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            OrderBuilder(_customer(), object())  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def test_for_customer_uses_flat_pricing(self) -> None:
        builder = OrderBuilder.for_customer(_customer())
        builder.add("EL-1001", 1, Money(1000))
        order = builder.build("ORD-1")
        self.assertIsInstance(order._pricing, FlatPricing)
        self.assertEqual(order.total, Money(1000))

    def test_for_customer_is_classmethod_returning_subclass(self) -> None:
        class _Sub(OrderBuilder):
            pass

        self.assertIsInstance(_Sub.for_customer(_customer()), _Sub)

    def test_add_returns_self_for_chaining(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        self.assertIs(b.add("EL-1001", 1, Money(1)), b)

    def test_add_validates_via_line_item(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            b.add("x", 1, Money(1))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            b.add("EL-1001", 0, Money(1))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            b.add("EL-1001", 1, 5)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        self.assertEqual(len(b), 0)

    def test_add_normalizes_sku(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        b.add(" el-1001 ", 1, Money(1))
        order = b.build("ORD-1")
        self.assertEqual(order.items[0].sku, "EL-1001")

    def test_build_empty_raises(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing()).build("ORD-1")
        self.assertEqual(str(ctx.exception), "no items")

    def test_build_produces_order_with_lines(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing(0))
        b.add("EL-1001", 2, Money(250)).add("GR-2001", 1, Money(300))
        order = b.build("ORD-5")
        self.assertIsInstance(order, Order)
        self.assertEqual(order.order_id, "ORD-5")
        self.assertIs(order.status, OrderStatus.NEW)
        self.assertEqual(order.total, Money(800))

    def test_build_merges_duplicate_skus(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        b.add("EL-1001", 1, Money(100)).add("EL-1001", 2, Money(100))
        order = b.build("ORD-1")
        self.assertEqual(len(order), 1)
        self.assertEqual(order.items[0].quantity, 3)

    def test_build_twice_creates_independent_orders(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        b.add("EL-1001", 1, Money(1))
        o1 = b.build("ORD-1")
        b.add("GR-2001", 1, Money(1))
        o2 = b.build("ORD-2")
        self.assertEqual(len(o1), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(o2), 2)

    def test_build_propagates_bad_order_id(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        b.add("EL-1001", 1, Money(1))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            b.build("")

    def test_len_and_bool(self) -> None:
        b = OrderBuilder(_customer(), FlatPricing())
        self.assertEqual(len(b), 0)
        self.assertFalse(b)
        b.add("EL-1001", 1, Money(1))
        self.assertEqual(len(b), 1)
        self.assertTrue(b)
